search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches found an official broader-category description and official sales totals, but no reliable source establishing the exact furniture-retailer ranking with a defined period, comparison set, and denominator. The remaining atom is unresolved.
The official IKEA source uses “home furnishing retailer,” not the claim’s narrower “furniture retailer.”
The official FY25 total covers sales of IKEA products, food, and services across franchisees; it is not a furniture-only ranking denominator.

The secondary source repeats the ranking but does not state its methodology, comparison set, or period. Reuters’ reference is to Ingka Group as an IKEA retailer, not to a global ranking of furniture retailers.
